tournaicathedral.name: Tournai Cathedral
tournaicathedral.slogan: Five stone towers rising over the Scheldt.
tournaicathedral.line: A tornado ripped through the city on 14 August 1999, and the cathedral's UNESCO listing followed in 2000.

monsbelfry.name: Belfry of Mons
monsbelfry.slogan: 87 metres of Baroque curls above the Grand-Place.
monsbelfry.line: Designed by Louis Ledoux in the 1660s, it is the only belfry in Belgium built in Baroque style.

boisducazier.name: Bois du Cazier
boisducazier.slogan: A pithead that still remembers every miner by name.
boisducazier.line: On 8 August 1956 a fire killed 262 miners here, 136 of them Italian.

grandhornu.name: Grand-Hornu
grandhornu.slogan: An industrial dream town built around one great courtyard.
grandhornu.line: Henri De Gorge built this model coal-mining community between 1810 and 1830.

saintewaudru.name: Sainte-Waudru Collegiate Church
saintewaudru.slogan: Home of the Car d'Or and the shrine of Mons' patron saint.
saintewaudru.line: Each Trinity Sunday the golden Car d'Or must be hauled up the steep Rampe Sainte-Waudru in one go, or misfortune is said to follow.
